# Callouts / Alerts

> [!NOTE]
> This is a note alert — blue border, blue-tinted background, info icon.

> [!TIP]
> This is a tip alert — brand-green border, green-tinted background, check/lightbulb icon.

> [!WARNING]
> This is a warning alert — amber border, amber-tinted background, alert-triangle icon.

> [!CAUTION]
> This is a caution/danger alert — red border, red-tinted background, stop/shield icon.

> [!NOTE]
> A callout can contain **bold**, `inline code`, and a [link](./internal-links.md).
